newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were little changed in thin trade on Wednesday with most traders sidelined ahead of the publication of U.S. jobless claims data and the U.S. gross domestic product (GDP) figure, dealers said.
Jobless claims are forecast to rise to 330,000 compared to July's 327,000 and the August GDP figure is forecast to remain unchanged at 4.2 percent. Both are due on Friday.
"Traders are not opening any new positions in the market but merely maintaining or just squaring off their positions," a local dealer said.
"There's only very slight adjusting with month-end funding," he added.

In short dates, Wednesday/Thursday rose 3/16 percentage point to 5-3/8 5-1/4 from Tuesday/Wednesday's 5-1/4 5-1/8 percent. Week-fixed also rose 1/16 percentage point to 5-3/8 5-1/4 from Tuesday's 5-5/16 5-3/16 percent.

Among term rates, one-month was unchanged at 5-7/16 5-5/16 percent, three-months unchanged at 5-1/2 5-3/8, nine-months rose 3/16 percentage point to 5-7/8 5-3/4 from Tuesday's 5-3/4 5-5/8 percent. Twelve-months also rose 3/16 percentage point to 6- 5-7/8 from Tuesday's 5-7/8 5-3/4 percent.
